scenario.description: Maya manages the family's four-bed backyard greenhouse and must make the final call about the planting layout, harvest distribution, safe gardening hours, and care schedule for the early summer growing season, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family greenhouse has four raised beds and is being prepared for the early summer growing season.
shared_context.S2: The expected harvest is about 40 kilograms of produce.
shared_context.S3: Maya is responsible for choosing the planting layout, deciding where the harvest goes, and organizing routine care.
shared_context.S4: The family usually has a check-in before planting so everyone can raise plans, limits, or information that should shape the garden.
shared_context.S5: The planting and care plan will cover June 1 through June 30, 2026.

PF1.text: Jordan spoke with the coordinator at the neighborhood food pantry, who said the pantry can receive exactly 24 kilograms of this harvest if the family labels it for pickup; this has not yet been shared with Maya.

PF2.text: Leah's migraine medication makes direct greenhouse work before 10:00 unsafe for her, so she can only garden starting at 10:00 or later.

PF3.text: Ravi had the beds tested by horticulturist Nina Patel, who found that Bed 3 has the acidic soil preparation needed for blueberries and recommended using that bed for blueberries with an acidic mix and no lime.

PF4.text: Tessa promised Maya privately that she will care for Bed 2 every Tuesday and Thursday from 18:00 to 19:00 throughout June, 2026, if that assignment is written into the plan.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 24 kilograms of the harvest must be allocated to the food pantry and the remaining 16 kilograms to the family.
Greenhouse work must begin at 10:00 or later.
Bed 3 must be planted with blueberries.
Bed 3 must use an acidic mix with no lime.
Bed 2 must be assigned to Tessa's Tuesday and Thursday 18:00-19:00 care schedule throughout June 2026.
A food-pantry pickup commitment must be recorded for exactly 24 kilograms.
A safe-hours commitment must state that greenhouse work begins at 10:00 or later or that no greenhouse tasks occur before 10:00.
A soil-preparation commitment must record the blueberry, acidic-mix, and no-lime plan.
A care commitment must assign Tessa to Bed 2 every Tuesday and Thursday from 18:00 to 19:00 throughout June 2026.
Jordan's pantry information must be spoken aloud and cited by Maya.

content_checks.C3: decisions['gardening_start_time'] in ['10:00', '10:00 AM', '10:00 or later', '10:00 AM or later', '10:00 AM or later for Leah\'s care tasks']
content_checks.C5: 'acidic' in decisions['bed_3_soil_plan'] and 'no lime' in decisions['bed_3_soil_plan']
content_checks.C6: 'Tuesday' in decisions['bed_2_care_schedule'] and 'Thursday' in decisions['bed_2_care_schedule'] and '18:00' in decisions['bed_2_care_schedule'] and '19:00' in decisions['bed_2_care_schedule'] and 'June 2026' in decisions['bed_2_care_schedule'] and any('Tessa' in (c['target'] + c['detail']) and 'Bed 2' in c['detail'] and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and 'Thursday' in c['detail'] and '18:00' in c['detail'] and '19:00' in c['detail'] and 'June 2026' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('24' in c['detail'] and ('kilograms' in c['detail'] or 'kg' in c['detail']) and 'pickup' in c['detail'] and 'food pantry' in (c['detail'] + c['target']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Leah' and (('10:00' in c['detail'] and 'later' in c['detail']) or ('no' in c['detail'] and 'before 10:00' in c['detail']) or ('10:00 AM' in c['detail'] and 'later' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('blueberries' in c['detail'] and 'acidic' in c['detail'] and 'no lime' in c['detail'] and 'Bed 3' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The pantry coordinator's exact capacity changes the food-pantry allocation from an unspecified family distribution to exactly 24 kilograms and creates the matching pickup commitment.
Leah's medication limit changes the gardening start time from an arbitrary morning hour to 10:00 or later and requires a safe-hours commitment.

The horticulturist's test changes Bed 3 from an ordinary vegetable planting to blueberries, changes its soil plan to acidic mix with no lime, and requires a commitment recording that specific preparation.
Tessa's specific promise changes Bed 2 from an unassigned or generic care arrangement to her Tuesday-and-Thursday 18:00-19:00 schedule throughout June and creates the matching care commitment.
